caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white, showing the front view of a simple, rectangular building with a gabled, tiled roof. The building features two large pillars at the left and right corners, extending from the ground to the roof. The façade displays a large central arched doorway with a smaller rectangular step at the threshold, and above this entry is a smaller, arched window set into the wall. The roof is illustrated with a texture resembling individual tiles. Below the image, there are two ribbon-like banners: the first, on the left, is inscribed with the number "1804;" the wider banner below the building contains handwritten text reading "mision santa ines" and the name "J. F. Jones" is signed at the right end of this banner. The composition centers the building on a blank background, with the text elements placed neatly underneath.
title: Mision Santa Ines
